description: Every third-party component compiled into yuzu-server: the web assets it serves (htmx, ECharts, three.js, Cytoscape.js, IBM Plex) and the C++ QR-code library. scripts/ci/artifact-sbom.py adds these to the SBOM of every release artifact that holds yuzu-server, and its `check-vendored` command (tests/test_vendored_components.py) fails when a file under the tracked roots is added or changed without a matching entry here. Refreshing a vendored file: update its entry (version, version_source, sha256, bytes) in the same change as the file, its NOTICE and the byte-count pin in tests/unit/server/test_static_js_bundle.cpp. A version is recorded only when the file itself or its NOTICE states it; otherwise version is null, version_status is "unresolved" and the reason says what is known.

components.name: htmx.org
components.title: htmx
components.version_source: The embedded bytes carry version:"2.0.4" in htmx's config object, and the header comment of static_js_bundle.cpp names HTMX 2.0.4. The bytes are npm htmx.org@2.0.4 dist/htmx.min.js (50,917 bytes) followed by one newline (checked 2026-11-18).

components.name: htmx-ext-sse
components.title: htmx Server Sent Events extension
components.version_source: The embedded file carries no version, and no NOTICE or comment in the tree names one. Its bytes are sse.js from npm htmx-ext-sse 2.2.2 and 2.2.3 (the file is identical in both releases) followed by one newline; they differ from 2.0.0, 2.1.0, 2.2.0, 2.2.1 and 2.2.4 (every release published as of 2026-11-18). The file cannot tell 2.2.2 from 2.2.3.

components.name: echarts
components.title: Apache ECharts
components.version_source: The file sets t.version="5.6.0" and server/core/vendor/echarts-NOTICE.txt names release 5.6.0. Byte-identical to npm echarts@5.6.0 dist/echarts.min.js (checked 2026-11-18).

components.name: zrender
components.title: ZRender (bundled inside echarts.min.js)
components.version_source: echarts.min.js carries ZRender's own export object with version:"5.6.1" (beside registerSSRDataGetter), under ZRender's banner. Agrees with echarts 5.6.0's package.json, which pins zrender 5.6.1 exactly.

components.name: tslib
components.title: tslib (helpers bundled inside echarts.min.js)
components.version_source: echarts.min.js carries tslib's licence banner (Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation, 0BSD text) but no tslib version. echarts 5.6.0's package.json pins tslib 2.3.0 exactly; that is upstream build metadata, not something the vendored file states.

components.name: three
components.title: three.js r168 and its OrbitControls
components.version_source: three.module.min.js begins with const t="168" (three.js REVISION) and three-NOTICE.txt names release r168 (npm 0.168.0). three-orbit-controls.js carries no version; three-orbit-NOTICE.txt names r168. Both files are byte-identical to npm three@0.168.0 (build/three.module.min.js and examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js, checked 2026-11-18).

components.name: cytoscape
components.title: Cytoscape.js
components.version_source: The file ends with Wh.version="3.33.3" (it has no banner) and server/core/static/cytoscape-NOTICE.txt names release 3.33.3. Byte-identical to npm cytoscape@3.33.3 dist/cytoscape.esm.min.mjs (checked 2026-11-18). It inlines three small MIT-licensed fragments with their own banners (a Promises/A+ thenable by Ralf S. Engelschall, a Bezier easing generator by Gaetan Renaudeau, a spring generator adapted from Framer.js by Koen Bok); they have no package of their own and are not listed separately.

components.name: plex-sans
components.title: IBM Plex Sans (Latin1 woff2, weights 400/500/600)
components.version_source: server/core/vendor/ibm-plex/ibm-plex-NOTICE.txt names @ibm/plex-sans 1.1.0 (font Version 3.005). The woff2 files are byte-identical to that package's fonts/split/woff2 files (checked 2026-11-18); the version inside the fonts' compressed name table was not read.

components.name: plex-mono
components.title: IBM Plex Mono (Latin1 woff2, weights 400/500)
components.version_source: server/core/vendor/ibm-plex/ibm-plex-NOTICE.txt names @ibm/plex-mono 2.5.0 (font Version 2.005). The woff2 files are byte-identical to that package's fonts/split/woff2 files (checked 2026-11-18); the version inside the fonts' compressed name table was not read.

components.name: qr-code-generator
components.title: Project Nayuki QR Code generator (C++), compiled into yuzu-server
components.version_source: server/core/vendor/qrcodegen/qrcodegen-NOTICE.txt says it is pinned to tag v1.8.0; the source files carry no version. Both files are byte-identical to cpp/qrcodegen.{cpp,hpp} at that tag (checked 2026-11-18).
